title: research: symlink TOCTOU race in wp11_keystore_create
description: wp11_keystore_create() opens the output path with fopen(path, 'wb') using mode 0600. On multi-user systems, an attacker could replace path with a symlink between the permission check (implicit in fopen) and the write, redirecting key material to an attacker-controlled file. Research: (1) is this a realistic threat in wolfP11's deployment contexts (embedded, single-user, containers)? (2) If multi-user Linux is in scope, fix with open(O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_WRONLY, 0600) which atomically fails if path already exists.
